description: This Java class provides an implementation of the 'substring-before' function used within a data processing pipeline. It supports extracting the substring before a specified string in the input value, using a parameterized signature. The class is immutable and interacts with other pipeline components such as 'PipelineElement' and 'ExpressionResolver'.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionSubstringBefore
classes.description: Implements the 'substring-before' function, providing methods to get its name, signature, and applying the function to input elements.

classes.name: SubstringBeforeFunctionSignature
classes.description: Defines the signature for the 'substring-before' function, including parameter definitions.

classes.name: GivenStringParam
classes.description: Specifies the parameter details ('givenString') for the 'substring-before' function.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function, 'substring-before'.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of the function.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the substring-before logic to a given PipelineElement, returning a new PipelineElement based on the condition.

methods.name: parseAndResolve
methods.description: Parses the parameters string and resolves the actual parameter using the expression resolver.
